name: Planted Explosive deals 2 damage to target unit when not prepared
notes: Planted Explosive's element is FIRE, matching the starting champion, so no lineage patch is needed. The champion starts with no preparation counters, so the optional Prepare 1 YESNO decision never queues, and the ability resolves to its base 2-damage mode rather than the prepared 4-damage mode. Without a [Class Bonus] discount, the full 2-reserve cost is paid; both players then decline the EffectStackActiveResponse opportunity window before the seeded Dungeon Guide is chosen as the target. Only the base (non-prepared) 2-damage effect is covered.

rulesClauses: Deal 2 damage to target unit. If CARDNAME was prepared, deal 4 damage to that unit instead.
